unit: U3 melt simulation (camera unit B: test shot Sh3a + Sh3b, defining beat)
direction: 2 'La coulee rendue' (defining beat), built from the approved test shot with the user's fixes; no drift to another direction
build_scripts: films/swarm/le-chant-du-styrene/melt-build/ (melt3.py simulation+shading+camera, render.py frames, compare3.py metrics+sheet, preview3.py kit.py preview, ledger.py this file, probe.py dev stills)
reproduce: cd films/swarm/le-chant-du-styrene/melt-build && python3 -I render.py 415 662 && python3 -I compare3.py && python3 -I preview3.py && python3 -I ledger.py
seed_note: numpy RandomState(1958) for the steel quilting; smooth_noise seeds 3 (channel wobble), 100-107 (boil bank, sigma 9), 200-207 (fine boil, sigma 3); boil reseeded every 2 frames (index (k//2) mod 8)

parameters.speed: 0.15 + (depth/D)^0.6, x (w_arm/w_median)^2 in arm channels, x0.6 in cavities, x1.6 in sprue
parameters.ior_note: PS n~1.59; displacement = 40 px x surface gradient

renders.format: 960x408 picture band only, no captions, no letterbox, no grain (editor applies the shared grain); PNG sequences + lossless libx264rgb crf 0 mp4, 24 fps; global frame index f, film time t = f/24

sh3a_dissolve_target.note: full melt in the open mould half seen frontally with EXACTLY the sh2b_hold camera (centre (9,26) world, zoom 0.75): dissolve U2's sh2b f0415-f0422 into these 8 frames, then continue with sh3a f0423. Check overlay: films/sources/le-chant-du-styrene/melt-simulation-camera-unit-b-test-shot-sh3a-sh3b-defining-beat-/dissolve_check_f0422_50pct.png

sh3a.content: full melt (boil at 0.35 amplitude, on twos) in the cavities of the steel; frontal sh2b_hold framing held to 18.00 s, then a slow tilt to 16 deg pitch with a 7% push by 20.80 (cut C2)

sh3b.content: closer 3/4 view (pitch 50->46 deg, yaw -9->-4, roll -6->-4.5, glide + push); fill-time field run backward: cavities empty far->near at 21.9 / 22.9 / 23.9 / 24.9 s, melt retracts up the runner, last melt down the sprue at 26.19 s; hold on four wet-lit warm hollows 26.2-27.6; focus pull from the first-emptied cavity to the sprue (0.3-4.9 s into the shot)

preview_with_sound.note: kit.py review preview, film 17.60-27.60 s, letterbox + L3 caption + U1 stems; not the editor's assembly

audio_for_editor.note: 44.1 kHz stereo slices (film 17.60-27.60) of the process-verse unit's stems; the picture's drain events were timed to that unit's cue sheet (cavity release 21.9/22.9/23.9/24.9, sprue glug 26.2), so drain.wav lines up without edits. press_foraged is the real Engel injection-moulding machine recording (CC BY 3.0, see evidence).

measurements.iou_method: cavity mask (depth>0.02, generated from geometry.json ellipse + bore fits at home_centre) vs U2's ring piece alpha placed unrotated with its ellipse centre at the same home_centre (the Sh2b hold pose: rotation 0, scale 1), both in plane coords (x1.25 of source px) and again projected by the hold camera
measurements.u2_hold_note: whole-object overlap of U2's rendered f0422 (lit warm pixels) with the projected mould mask; lower than the per-ring IoU because U2's runner shows the standing sprue post and four legs, which in the mould half are a well at the hub and not channels
measurements.drain_order_note: cavity ids 0..3 = geometry.json rings 1..4 (1 left arm, 2 up-right, 3 right, 4 down). Order 3 (right, narrowest 8 px arm) -> 1 (left) -> 4 (down) -> 2 (up-right, shortest wide arm, nearest the sprue). 1.0 s between releases (test shot had 0.3 s).
measurements.stats_note: inside the 960x408 band; luminance Rec.709; lit = lum>25; warm = hue <55 or >340 deg; blue = 200-250 deg. Plastic brightened as asked: band p99 ~164-169 during the melt (test shot ~88), max <=205 (no whites). Hollows at the end stay warm: at 27.5 s lit pixels are 0.56 warm (the hollows and runner) and 0.42 blue (the practical lamps, now visible as asked by the plan); the test shot was 0.03 warm. Blue practical present in every measured still (0.16-0.42).

comparison_sheet: films/swarm/le-chant-du-styrene/melt-shot-compare-24.0s.jpg (Sh3b @24.0 s | proposals/kf-2.png | styreneA.webp band | Sh3b @27.5 s hollows, each with its band stats)

fixes_from_test_shot_review.brighter_amber_cores: source E=(1.50,1.50,1.05), alpha=(0.45,1.30,3.2), thin runner depth 0.40 vs ring 1.0-1.25: runner reads amber-orange, rings deep red; band p99 164-169, max ~204 (shared U2 roll-off knee 0.66)
fixes_from_test_shot_review.warm_hollows: lasting wet coat (3.5% of depth, concentrated where walls meet floor and in the rib grooves) at a longer optical path -> dim red-amber; warm key (1.0,0.50,0.20) on the walls facing the source; no cold steel grey
fixes_from_test_shot_review.legible_order: hesitation model + monotone re-timing: releases 1.0 s apart (21.9/22.9/23.9/24.9) instead of 0.3 s
fixes_from_test_shot_review.foraged_sound: the process-verse unit found and licensed a real injection-moulding machine recording (CC BY 3.0); sliced here for this span and used in the preview
fixes_from_test_shot_review.kept: asymmetry (flip IoU 0.13), refraction of the steel photograph through the melt surface gradient (40 px x grad), broad textured spill (narrow 6 px halo cut to 0.08 to avoid a constant-width glow), Beer-Lambert thickness colour, meniscus specular, boil on twos + Whitney oscillator bank, focus pull

techniques.8_sutherland_constraint_sketchpad: one constraint graph (geometry.json): ring ellipse+bore attached-to home_centre (= gate + support radius, U2's contact constraint), arms = measured polylines hub->gate, sprue at hub. The cavity/channel field and the fill-time graph are generated from it; residual = IoU 0.96-0.97 (>=0.85).
techniques.29_grabcut: used through U2's GrabCut pieces/masks: channel widths are measured on bare_runner_mask.png by distance transform along each arm (13.6, 20.4, 8.0, 20.4 src px); ring silhouettes for the IoU test are the GrabCut alphas.
techniques.6_whitney_harmonic: meniscus oscillator bank: per cavity partials p=1..3 at p*w_i, w_i = 2pi*0.42*1.5^(i mod 2)*(1+0.5*(i//2)) (2:3 chain), 3-fold angular mode, advanced on twos
techniques.44_multiplane: blue practicals on their own plane (U2's lamps, same positions/colours), 0.3x drift; seen directly past the plate edge and reflected by the polished plate (x1.15, texture-modulated); plate on its own perspective plane

handmade.what: cavity/channel/sprue depth field generated from geometry.json (ellipse+bore cavities with deeper rim, rib groove with 3 slots, tapered gates, sprue well)

fill-time field: weighted geodesic (Dijkstra, 2 px grid, normalized-convolution upsampling) from the sprue, speed 0.15+(depth/D)^0.6 (wall lag), x(w/w_med)^2 per arm (Poiseuille), x0.6 in cavities; hesitation delay (0.7 overlap) for unbalanced branches; monotone re-timing to the cue sheet; melt shown where t_drain + eta > t (equivalently T'+eta' < tau, tau running from full to 0)

Beer-Lambert thickness colour (two passes through the melt off the polished floor), refraction of F-steel by the melt-surface gradient, specular on the meniscus, two-scale spill on the steel, grazing-wall darkening (no glow outline), lasting wet coat in the hollows, warm raking key
pinhole perspective of the plate: frontal hold (=sh2b_hold) -> slow tilt (Sh3a), 3/4 glide (Sh3b), thin-lens focus pull, the shared halation + roll-off of the cutout unit
two defocused blue practical lamps (U2's disc and bar), own plane, 0.3x drift, plus their reflection in the plate

declared_substitutions: Molten polystyrene does not glow: the melt's light is the warm source reflected from the polished cavity floor through the pigmented melt (lighting choice, Beer-Lambert computed).
The plate texture is quilted from plain areas of the CC0 photograph, not the photograph's own layout; the cavities are handmade from the runner geometry.
In the mould half the runner's standing sprue post is a well at the hub; U2's puppet legs/post have no channel counterpart.
The drain order uses a declared hesitation model (unbalanced branches fill in turn with 70% overlap) and a monotone re-timing of the fill-time field to the verse cue sheet.
The runner and rings' red/amber colour follows the film's declared teal->red/amber gel substitution (U2), here computed as Beer-Lambert thickness colour.
absences: No real red or amber translucent runner photograph under an allowed licence (U2/U1 search; not repeated here).

No open-licence footage or photograph of molten plastic filling or draining a mould cavity was used: the Moving Image Archive cache has no plastics footage (plan.md, U1); this unit did no new search and made the melt by simulation.
No open recording of melt suction/drain; the drain sound is U1's handmade drain stem.
